annotations.text:
Four screens covering the brief.

Deals dashboard — cheapest options nationwide, ranked by monthly rate, with vehicle type, company, location, dates, total, monthly average and a booking link.

Location scope — which US locations get scanned, and what that costs before you commit.

Prices are real, from the live Atlanta scan on 7 Sep 2026: Pathfinder $1,178, Pacifica $1,493, Odyssey $1,651.

The price-history trend and the other cities are illustrative — only Atlanta has been scanned so far.
Note the $1,100 target line on the history chart sits below every real price found. That gap is the open commercial question, not a design detail.
